vis.alt: Pathology of myasthenia gravis: autoantibodies against the acetylcholine receptor, MuSK or LRP4 reduce functional receptors, so repeated use causes fatigable weakness with ptosis and diplopia; edrophonium or pyridostigmine improve it; thymoma should be looked for.
